content.comment_body: Hello, following the tutorial, I created an application on AWS using [product_name] [version_no] and [product_name]. analysis.insight_summary: The user has successfully connected [product_name] [version_no] and [product_name] to AWS IoT Core, enabling direct data interactions. They found the built-in trend feature inadequate for logging 0-10V analog signals and are unsure about the scalability regarding the number of independent applications/devices on AWS. Guidance is needed for long-term (monthly) data logging and visualization, and clarification is sought on which AWS services could support these requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects robust monthly analog data trend monitoring through AWS cloud integration with [product_name], scalable across multiple devices. They seek straightforward instructions on necessary AWS services to achieve comprehensive data logging and visualization.
